name: image_generate
description: Generate or edit images using the configured FAL.ai image model. Returns the generated image URL and local MEDIA:<path>.

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the desired image (text-to-image) or the edit to apply (image-to-image). Be detailed and descriptive.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image. 'landscape' is 16:9 wide, 'portrait' is 16:9 tall, 'square' is 1:1.

image_url.description: Optional source image URL or local path for image-to-image editing (when supported by the configured model).

reference_image_urls.description: Optional list of reference image URLs for multi-reference editing (when supported by the configured model).

seed.description: Optional integer seed for reproducible generation.
